newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast 1996 HUF EPS up 39.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast 1996 HUF EPS up 39.7 pct.

text.p: Hungarian plastics company Pannonplast Muanyagipari Rt said on Thursday that its earnings per share (EPS) rose by 39.7 percent in forint terms and by 18.8 percent in dollar terms in 1996 over 1995.
"Earnings per share grew dynamically," Pannonplast said in its earnings report. "EPS in 1996 was 390.16 forints, an equivalent of 39.7 percent increase (over 1995)," it said.
"The dollar denominated EPS is $2.39 which is higher than that in 1995 by 18.8 percent," it added.

Pannonplast's preliminary consolidated IAS 1996 results issued on Thursday showed net income of 1.42 billion forints in 1996 on sales of 9.67 billion against a net profit of 838.2 million forints on sales of 8.28 billion in 1995.
"With relatively lower sales revenues due to depressed raw material prices as well as improving gross and net margins, the group generated a net income of 1.42 billion forints."
Pannonplast's sales revenues rose by 16.9 percent year-on-year.
Relatively depressed international raw material prices were the main reason for below-inflation growth, the company said.
